name: open_member_subaccount
title: Open a secondary savings sub-account for a member and reach the posting confirmation
goal: Open a new secondary savings sub-account for member {{memberId}} with nickname {{nickname}} and an initial deposit of {{initialDeposit}}, and reach the posting confirmation screen showing the reference number. Start from member inquiry: look the member up first, then use sub-account maintenance.

params.name: nickname
params.description: Operator-facing nickname for the new sub-account

policy.//: Posting an account opening is irreversible, so this capability may never run unattended and every invocation must carry an explicit confirmation.
